data.one_liner: Utility for generating list markers in many numbering styles
data.what_it_does: Provides a Counter class that tracks a numeric value and a CounterStyle system that can format that value into various list markers (Roman, alphabetic, CJK, etc.). It also allows defining custom styles and managing them via a registry.
use_when: You need numbered or bulleted lists in multiple languages or custom numbering schemes
You want a pure Dart solution without external dependencies
You need to generate list markers for documentation or UI components
avoid_when: You require complex layout or styling beyond simple markers
You need integration with a UI framework that already provides list widgets
strengths: Wide range of predefined styles covering many languages
Supports custom additive and other systems
weaknesses: No UI components, only marker generation
Limited to list markers, not full list widgets
No performance benchmarks for very large lists
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, no special permissions
